messages.content: Hello! I am **CivicPulse AI**, your municipal assistant. I can answer questions from our official city FAQs, explain error codes (like 400, 401, 403, 404, 422, 429, 500, 503), or file an official support ticket for you. How can I help today?
What does Error 403 mean in CivicPulse?

### Error 403: Forbidden (Access Denied — Role Authorization Failure)

Your authenticated identity does not have sufficient role privileges to perform this municipal operation.

**Common Cause:** A citizen user attempted to access the Staff Triage Operations desk, assign field crews, or modify official resolution audit records.

**Recommended Action:** Official case management is restricted to authorized municipal staff. Switch to Staff Inspector persona in Settings to test this action.

*Would you like me to open a support ticket for this error?* Just say "File a ticket".
Can you please create a support ticket for my street?

I have created a high-priority Municipal Support Ticket for you: **#tkt-QJ31CU**.

Our city dispatch supervisor desk has been notified and will follow up with you at **elena.rostova@civicpulse.org**. You can track this case anytime in your citizen portal.
